name: Matthew
author: Traditionally the apostle Matthew. The book itself is anonymous.
date: Often dated between about AD 60 and 85.
setting: Written with a strong Jewish background, showing Jesus as the fulfillment of the Old Testament.
genre: Gospel: a narrative of Jesus’ life with five major teaching sections.
theme: Jesus is the Messiah and king who brings the kingdom of heaven.

outline.label: The church and the cross approaching

christInBook: Matthew presents Jesus as the promised Messiah, the son of David and son of Abraham, who fulfills the Law and the Prophets. He is Immanuel, “God with us” (1:23), and he ends with the promise, “I am with you always” (28:20).
howToRead: Matthew gathers Jesus’ teaching into five great discourses, each ending with a phrase such as “when Jesus had finished these sayings.” Watch for the phrase “this was to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet.”
